处方应由接诊医师本人开具，严禁使用人工智能等自动生成处方: Prescriptions should be issued by the treating physician in person, and the use of artificial intelligence or other auto-generated prescriptions is strictly prohibited.
多位专家指出，目前在临床诊疗中，AI更多起到的作用是支持和辅助临床决策: Multiple experts have pointed out that currently in clinical diagnosis and treatment, AI primarily plays a role in supporting and assisting clinical decision-making.
“比如，AI在医学影像领域的应用，可加快高清图像获取、图像生成，并提升信噪比和清: "For example, the application of AI in the medical imaging field can accelerate the acquisition of high-definition images and image generation, improve signal-to-noise ratio and clarity, and help with rapid screening and identification of lesions."
AI可以提供一定的诊断支持和建议，但处方仍应由接诊医师开具，并经人工核验: AI can provide certain diagnostic support and recommendations, but prescriptions should still be issued by the treating physician and verified manually.
现实中，AI仍面临诸多挑战，比如AI模型的数据质量、泛化能力有待提升等: In reality, AI still faces many challenges, such as the data quality and generalization capability of AI models needing improvement.
专家表示，不能完全依赖AI是行业共识: Experts indicated that complete reliance on AI is not an industry consensus.
在诊疗行为中，AI需要在医务人员的监督下使用，医生也不能过度依赖AI技术，忽略自: In diagnostic and therapeutic practices, AI must be used under the supervision of medical personnel, and doctors cannot over-rely on AI technology while neglecting their own professional judgment and individual patient needs.
其次，因AI诊疗导致医疗事故，谁来负责: Second, if a medical accident occurs due to AI-assisted diagnosis and treatment, who bears the responsibility
受访专家均指出，医疗机构作为医疗服务核心主体，在AI辅助诊疗的过程中始终是第一责: All interviewed experts pointed out that the medical institution, as the core subject of medical services, remains the primary responsible party throughout the process of AI-assisted diagnosis and treatment.
“AI始终是医生的辅助工具: "AI is always an auxiliary tool for doctors."
”黄薛冰认为，“我们不能将AI定义为超越医生和医护人员的、技术更高级的、可以自己: "Huang Xuebing believes that 'we cannot define AI as an entity that surpasses doctors and medical staff, possesses superior technology, and can independently bear primary responsibility.'"
“从法律层面来看，目前国内外法律政策普遍将医疗人工智能视为一种产品: "From a legal perspective, both domestic and foreign laws and policies generally view medical artificial intelligence as a type of product."
”北京中医药大学卫生健康法学教授邓勇说，人工智能侵权问题需具体问题具体分析，往往: "Deng Yong, a professor of health and healthcare law at Beijing University of Chinese Medicine, says that AI liability issues require case-by-case analysis and often involve difficulties in identifying the causes of infringement and challenges in judicial adjudication."
“若因技术性故障导致AI决策错误，一般由器械或智能体提供者承担责任，医疗机构可向: "If AI decision errors result from technical faults, the responsibility generally lies with the device or intelligent system provider, and the medical institution may seek compensation from the responsible party."
邓勇建议，进一步完善相关法规，加强AI医疗产品的审批和监管: Deng Yong suggests further improving relevant regulations and strengthening the approval and supervision of AI medical products
患者必须清楚了解AI技术对其诊疗过程的影响，有权知晓并决定是否接受AI辅助诊疗: Patients must clearly understand the impact of AI technology on their diagnostic and treatment processes and have the right to know and decide whether to accept AI-assisted diagnosis and treatment
培养挺膺于AI潮头的时代新人（书里书外）: Cultivating new people of the times who stand at the forefront of the AI tide (inside and outside the book)
更深层次的，是面对AI强大的能力，人们对传统意义上学习价值的忧虑: More deeply, people harbor concerns about the value of traditional learning in the face of AI's powerful capabilities
这也是我在《AI时代学生画像》一书中，尝试解答的问题: This is also a question I attempt to answer in my book
其实，真正值得深思的，不是学习的内容在AI时代是否有用，而是我们的教育理念，能否: In fact, what truly deserves reflection is not whether the content of learning is useful in the AI age, but whether our educational philosophy can adapt to the core competencies that future society needs and AI cannot replace
对于AI带来的改变，不必过度焦虑: There is no need to be overly anxious about the changes brought by AI
AI不是替代人类的对手，而是拓展能力的助手: AI is not an adversary that replaces humans, but a tool that expands human capabilities
AI正在“撞击”教育，但并非摧毁教育，而是促进其从“工业化流水线”转向“生态化成: AI is "impacting" education, but not destroying it; rather, it is promoting its transformation from an "industrial assembly line" to an "ecological growth system"
纵观人类教育史，从口传心授到数字革命，AI正催生教育范式的第三次跃迁: Throughout the history of human education, from oral transmission to digital revolution, AI is catalyzing the third paradigm shift in education
AI可以帮助我们因材施教，为学生提供定制式教学服务: AI can help us teach according to each student's aptitude and provide customized teaching services
以语文教学为例，不少学校一个语文老师要教两个班、100多名学生，很难精细批改每个: Taking Chinese language teaching as an example, many schools have one Chinese language teacher teaching two classes with over 100 students, making it difficult to carefully revise each student's composition and provide targeted detailed guidance. Now we can input the composition and requirements into an AI system to get revision suggestions, which is equivalent to each student having their own personal "tutor"
不变无以面对未来，也要提防不恰当地使用AI进行教学: We must adapt to face the future, while also being vigilant against inappropriate use of AI in teaching
用好AI，不是仅仅在课表中新增一门AI课程，而是要将先进的技术恰当合理地融入各学: Using AI well is not merely adding a new AI course to the curriculum, but appropriately and reasonably integrating advanced technology into the teaching of various subjects, reorganizing and adjusting existing courses such as Chinese, mathematics, music, and art to form a curriculum system that meets the requirements of the times
一是开发AI学伴，将“课程”变为“学程”，赋能个性化教学，学生自己决定学什么、怎: First, develop AI learning companions, transforming "courses" into "learning pathways," empowering personalized teaching where students decide what to learn and how to learn
二是在人工智能协助下，突破死记硬背、被动刷题的学习方式，打破学科壁垒，设计基于真: Second, with the assistance of artificial intelligence, break free from rote memorization and passive practice drills, transcend disciplinary boundaries, and design task-driven learning, exploratory learning, and collaborative learning based on real-world problems
三是利用AI技术打造数字化教学场景，为学生提供灵活多样的具体情境，提高学生在实践: Third, leverage AI technology to create digital teaching scenarios that provide students with flexible and diverse concrete contexts, enhancing their ability to apply knowledge in practice
AI发展得越快，就越提醒我们：教育的全部目的，是为了培养活跃的智慧，使学生能立即: The faster AI develops, the more it reminds us that the entire purpose of education is to cultivate active wisdom, enabling students to immediately and deeply apply what they have learned to real life, to observe, understand, and create
2021年全国两会期间，我提出好的教育应该培养“四者”，引发网友共鸣，置身AI时: During the 2021 National Two Sessions, I proposed that good education should cultivate the "four types," which resonated with online audiences. Now, in the AI era, I wish to reiterate this proposition: in an innovative educational ecosystem centered on human development, people of the times who stand at the forefront of the AI tide should have this profile—they are lifelong athletes with healthy physiques
”邓勇表示，AI因其决策过程的复杂性和结果的不可预测性，设计者和生产者作为主要责: "Deng Yong stated that due to AI's complex decision-making processes and unpredictable results, designers and producers, as the primary responsible parties, must fully consider the system's intended scope of use and potential risks during the product design phase"
“从数据收集、数据处理，到数据使用，医疗大模型都需要遵循合法、正当、必要的原则，: "From data collection and data processing to data utilization, medical large models must adhere to the principles of legality, propriety, and necessity. They not only need to ensure that training data is lawful and compliant, avoiding collection of personal information unrelated to the services provided, but also must meet the requirements of medical ethics review"
